intro_md: Profile Customization changes the nameplate, backdrop, or pointer other players see around your account. Titles, Profile Banners, and Cursors may share a menu, but their unlocks stretch from Trophies and achievements to units, staff roles, competitions, shops, and bundles.
description_md:
## Choosing a customization type

Titles add a named label to your profile identity. Profile Banners change its visual backdrop, while Cursors replace the normal pointer with a themed design. Pick the slot you actually want to change before spending, because a handsome banner remains stubbornly unable to move your cursor.

Some names appear across more than one type, but each entry is a separate unlock. Earning a title does not automatically grant a banner with the same theme unless its own Obtainment requirement is also completed.

## Trophy, achievement, and unit unlocks

Trophy Exchange is the broad purchase route for many Profile Banners, available Cursors, and a Trophy-linked Title. Compare the listed Trophy costs across types before buying so one decorative slot does not quietly consume the budget for another.

Achievement rewards can come from Story clears, Paragon goals, Boss Event categories, or named Unit achievement groups. Unit-linked rewards instead ask you to obtain or evolve the exact character form in Obtainment, so Normal, evolved, and special variants should not be treated as interchangeable.

## Shop and bundle routes

Shop customization follows the named store or event. Occult Shop banners marked Unavailable cannot be earned through their old purchase route, even if the banner name still appears in the customization menu.

Bundle rewards follow the same rule. A Cursor tied to an unavailable bundle has no active purchase route unless that offer returns, and the old bundle name is not a secret checkout button hiding behind better lighting.

## Leaderboard, staff, and special rewards

Leaderboard and Tournament titles are tied to a specific season, update, mode, or placement range. Limited or special status means they should be treated as competitive or historical awards, not permanent tasks that any player can finish later.

Staff titles belong to roles such as developer, owner, administrator, moderator, helper, tester, creator, or Wiki staff. These are role awards rather than progression rewards, so normal gameplay cannot substitute for the listed position.

## Reading availability

Available marks a route that is treated as open. Unavailable means the named event, shop, unit season, or bundle route has ended, while Limited or special covers restricted roles, one-time awards, and seasonal competition rewards.

Always pair Status with Obtainment. The requirement explains what the reward belongs to, while the status tells you whether that route is a practical goal now or a badge from an earlier moment.
how_it_works_md: Status shows whether an unlock is available, unavailable, or limited to a special route. Customization type identifies the profile slot, and Obtainment gives the Trophy, achievement, unit, shop, leaderboard, staff, gamepass, or bundle requirement.

description_json.Titles: Titles add a named label to the player's profile and come from Trophies, units, achievements, gamepasses, staff roles, leaderboards, Tournaments, or special awards. Limited and special titles are not normal progression tasks.
description_json.Profile Banners: Profile Banners change the visual backdrop and can come from Trophies, unit ownership, achievements, event shops, or seasonal modes. An unavailable banner keeps its old requirement without offering a current unlock route.
description_json.Cursors: Cursors replace the normal pointer with a unit-themed design. Available Cursors use Trophies, while an unavailable bundle Cursor depends on that old offer returning.

faq_json.q: What can Profile Customization change in Anime Vanguards?
faq_json.a: Titles add a named label, Profile Banners change the backdrop, and Cursors replace the normal pointer with a themed design.

faq_json.q: Which profile rewards can be bought with Trophies?
faq_json.a: Trophy Exchange includes a Title, many Profile Banners, and available Cursors. Each entry's Obtainment requirement shows its Trophy cost.

faq_json.q: Do unit-linked profile rewards require the exact unit form?
faq_json.a: Yes. Follow the full unit name in Obtainment because obtaining a base form does not automatically satisfy a requirement for an evolved or special form.

faq_json.q: Can regular players unlock staff titles through gameplay?
faq_json.a: No. Developer, owner, administrator, moderator, helper, tester, creator, and Wiki staff titles are tied to the listed role rather than normal progression.

faq_json.q: Can an old leaderboard title still be earned?
faq_json.a: Only if its specific season or competition route is active. Limited or special leaderboard titles should not be assumed to remain available after their named period ends.

faq_json.q: What does Unavailable mean for a banner or Cursor?
faq_json.a: Its listed event, shop, seasonal unit, or bundle route is not open. The old requirement explains the original unlock but does not create a current way to earn it.

wiki_md: Profile Customization covers Titles, Profile Banners, and Cursors that change a label, backdrop, or pointer. Unlocks can use Trophies, achievements, unit ownership or evolution, shops, leaderboards, staff roles, gamepasses, and bundles. Availability separates practical goals from retired routes and restricted awards, so the status matters as much as the requirement.
